name: TURN change
about: A feature, fix or design change for TURN, with its intent marked
title: "TURN: "

## Intent
What should the player be able to do, see or hear that they can't today? Why does it matter?

## Must
What is non-negotiable. Anything not listed here is open to judgement.

-

## Example
What a mockup, screenshot or wording only illustrates. Say which parts are placeholders, such as worst-case names, counts or lengths.

-

## Done when
How you'll check it on a device, and on which one.
